text:
Carla: quick flagging — noticed a spike in "unattributed" rows on the quota dashboard for a subset of tenants. correlates with a TS SDK canary that flipped the compact-metadata opt-in.
Ben: is this the change where we moved sampling bits into x-compact-route?
Carla: yes. TS sent only x-compact-route when opt-in=true. proxy canonicalizer drops unknown headers so console never sees routing metadata.
Megan: saw similar in staging. our dashboard aggregation code checks headers in order: x-route, x-tenant, then parses legacy metadata. it doesn't know about x-compact-route at all.
Alice: we should avoid a large console schema change mid-week. short-term shim in proxy that translates x-compact-route -> x-route (preserve hash) seems safest.
Dan: agree. I'll open a small proxy config patch. infra-bot: Change request created CR-4591, requires approval and rollout window.
Erin: we need to be careful: compact encodes sampling and affinity. mapping blindly could change routing behavior for affinity-based caches. add a field x-route-mapped: compact so downstream can detect.
Ben: good call. Also we should emit a telemetry event routed.header.mapped with details (source: sdk-ts, mapped_to: x-route) so we can count mappings.
Carla: add a reconciliation query so billing can check token attribution after mapping. quick ClickHouse example: SELECT countIf(is_attributed=0) AS unattributed FROM quotas WHERE event_time > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR;
Megan: timeline: canary proxy mapping to infra-zone-1 in 20m, monitor 45m, then ramp. console-side PR to accept x-compact-route in parsing will follow; it's lower-risk but takes longer to deploy.
Alice: SDK changes: TS and Go clients should dual-write headers for 3 months: emit x-compact-route plus legacy x-route with header x-route-compat: 'dual-write'. Python already planned to do this in its next minor.
Dan: release steps for proxy change:
```
# enable mapping in proxy (canary)
PATCH /infra/api/v1/proxy/configs/route_mapping
{ "source_header": "x-compact-route", "target_header": "x-route", "add_tag": "x-route-mapped: compact" }
```
Ben: for SDK publish checklist (TS): bump minor, test dual-write in e2e, npm publish --tag beta, run canary clients, then promote to latest if metrics stable.
Megan: monitoring: look at quota attribution rate, affinity miss-rate, and a regression on tail latency. set an alert if unattributed > baseline + 5% for 30m.
Erin: I'll prepare the telemetry event and add it to the stats ingestion mapping. console team: please make mapped headers show up in audit logs but not count as separate routes in quota sums.
Alice: question — what if a customer intentionally uses compact to opt into a different routing policy? mapping could hide that intent.
Dan: we will preserve the compact payload in the mapped header (no transformation), and add x-route-mapped-source: sdk-ts so the console can filter those and show them in the routing-change audit view.
Carla: customer comms: short note saying "We've temporarily mapped new SDK compact header to our routing header to avoid quota gaps. Please upgrade SDKs to dual-write in the next release to avoid surprises." I'll draft and loop in support.
release-bot: TS SDK v1.9.0-beta published to npm :rocket:
Ben: follow-ups: 1) console parsing PR (accept x-compact-route) 2) proxy mapping canary (Dan) 3) SDK dual-write rollout (Megan + Ben) 4) migrate docs + deprecation schedule (Carla) 5) reconcile ledger after 48h (Finance).
Megan: I'll coordinate the SDK release notes and include sample migration snippet for TS and Go.
Carla: thanks. keeping this thread as single source of truth. I'll update CR-4591 with the postmortem after the ramp. :thumbsup:
